ai_incidents_closure_chk.name: ai_incidents_closure_chk
ai_incidents_closure_chk.value: status not in ('corrected', 'closed') or (correction_note is not null and length(btrim(correction_note)) > 0)

ai_model_register_approval_chk.name: ai_model_register_approval_chk
ai_model_register_approval_chk.value: status <> 'approved' or (approved_at is not null and evaluated_at is not null)

ai_risk_assessments_approval_chk.name: ai_risk_assessments_approval_chk
ai_risk_assessments_approval_chk.value: status = 'draft' or (approved_by_user_id is not null and approved_at is not null)

learning_contribution_grants_confirmed_c.name: learning_contribution_grants_confirmed_chk
learning_contribution_grants_confirmed_c.value: status = 'revoked' or (confirmations @> array['client_information_authority', 'third_party_rights', 'policy_accepted']::text[] and basis is not null and length(btrim(basis)) >= 10)

learning_policy_versions_published_chk.name: learning_policy_versions_published_chk
learning_policy_versions_published_chk.value: status = 'draft' or (published_at is not null and privacy_assessment_ref is not null)

learning_releases_approval_chk.name: learning_releases_approval_chk
learning_releases_approval_chk.value: status = 'draft' or (privacy_signoff_staff_id is not null and approved_by_staff_id is not null and approved_by_staff_id <> privacy_signoff_staff_id)

learning_reviews_reviewed_chk.name: learning_reviews_reviewed_chk
learning_reviews_reviewed_chk.value: stage = 'privacy' or decision = 'rejected' or reviewed is not null

learning_withdrawal_requests_scope_chk.name: learning_withdrawal_requests_scope_chk
learning_withdrawal_requests_scope_chk.value: scope is null or scope in ('structured_cases', 'photos', 'evaluation', 'model_training')

learning_withdrawal_requests_completed_c.name: learning_withdrawal_requests_completed_chk
learning_withdrawal_requests_completed_c.value: status = 'requested' or completed_at is not null

organisation_ai_settings_disclosure_chk.name: organisation_ai_settings_disclosure_chk
organisation_ai_settings_disclosure_chk.value: not ai_features_enabled or (disclosure_text is not null and disclosure_version > 0)

properties_coordinates_pair_check.name: properties_coordinates_pair_check
properties_coordinates_pair_check.value: ("properties"."latitude" is null and "properties"."longitude" is null) or ("properties"."latitude" is not null and "properties"."longitude" is not null)

scottish_epc_certificates_rating_chk.name: scottish_epc_certificates_rating_chk
scottish_epc_certificates_rating_chk.value: (current_rating is null or current_rating ~ '^[A-G]$') and (potential_rating is null or potential_rating ~ '^[A-G]$')

wording_clauses_source_chk.name: wording_clauses_source_chk
wording_clauses_source_chk.value: source = 'firm_authored' or (source = 'licensed_third_party' and licence_reference is not null and length(btrim(licence_reference)) > 0)

wording_clauses_approval_chk.name: wording_clauses_approval_chk
wording_clauses_approval_chk.value: status = 'draft' or (approved_by_user_id is not null and approved_at is not null)
